scientific_role: Replace the invalid unconditional-probability architecture with an explicit national-state-conditioned conventional forecast surface.

parent_diagnostics.interpretation: National state is a major missing variable, but the remaining territorial error law is regime-dependent.

2026_base.registered_N: Frozen local_N_posterior centre values; latent, not official 2026 local registered counts.
2026_base.turnout: Retain F-1 structural 2021 turnout mean for the deterministic scenario surface. Turnout uncertainty remains a separate conventional module; it is not inferred from national vote scenarios because 2021 local registered counts are unavailable for a clean historical national-turnout conditioning test.
2026_base.valid_vote_fraction: Same frozen F-1 valid-vote observation model.
2026_base.ballot_support: 2021 observed positive-vote lists only, exactly as the frozen F-1 provisional support. This is NOT the final 2026 ballot.

national_scenarios.definition: Apply the historical national multiplicative share ratio 2016/2011 to the 2021 national composition, then renormalize. This is a stress replay, not a probability or prediction.
Apply the historical national multiplicative share ratio 2021/2016 to the 2021 national composition, then renormalize. This is a stress replay, not a probability or prediction.

territorial_styles_each_national_scenari.definition: For every territory, multiply 2021 local shares by scenario_national_share / 2021_national_share and renormalize.
Add in CLR space the territory-specific residual left after oracle national proportional swing in 2011_TO_2016, mapped to the same canonical territory.
Add in CLR space the territory-specific residual left after oracle national proportional swing in 2016_TO_2021, mapped to the same canonical territory.

regional_bridge: Apply the national proportional swing to the 2021 regional ballot and add the mean local CLR residual of the selected territorial style within the region. There is no historical pre-2021 regional-system transition, so regional residual replay is explicitly a structural bridge, not calibrated evidence.

outputs: national 395-seat bucket totals for each territorial style
min/max 395-seat envelope across the three territorial styles for each national scenario
per-territory conditional vote shares and seats

promotion_boundary.reason: No 2026 legal ballot certification and no defensible probabilities over national scenarios.
